contract: Resolve complete Depends/Pre-Depends closure from target binary-package metadata, including alternatives and version constraints. Do not copy amd64 binaries or infer a resolved SPE closure from this seed list.
boot_policy: Shell-first is allowed. Start the desktop through the packaged PAM/login and Xsession path; LightDM can follow. A single human account does not remove service users or session dependencies.
preserve: maintainer scripts and generated debhelper snippets
system and user bus service activation
logind seats, runtime directory and device ACLs
complete installed root and dpkg database
explicitly_not_accepted_baseline: software-only EFL options as default desktop configuration
manual evdev/no-udev fallback as normal hardware setup
handwritten bundle status as evidence of Debian package closure
acceptance: Dependencies configured in target environment with no pending package errors
Normal PAM/login establishes /run/user/UID and session bus
E profile modules present with their runtime dependencies
QEMU software GL and SPE demos pass
Physical A1222 memory, SMP, input, SSH and Radeon separately verified

browser.purpose: Compact graphical browser for local documentation and basic web pages
browser.limitation: Modern web application/JavaScript compatibility is limited; not a Firefox replacement
acceptance: Pinned Debian source and complete target dependency closure
X11 text, images, scrolling, HTTPS and certificate validation on the target
browser.fallback: Choose a fuller engine separately if modern web applications are required

package_repository.format: Signed Debian APT repository served over lab HTTP

essential_bootstrap_contract: Resolve the selected Debian Essential: yes set and its implicit runtime dependencies as well as explicit Depends/Pre-Depends; BusyBox applets are not assumed compatible replacements for package-maintenance tools.

dependency_policy.resolver: apt on real target package indexes; reference metadata is planning evidence only
dependency_policy.acceptance: Full desktop seed closure must resolve and configure; an Essential-only simulation is not desktop acceptance
